verdict.label: no validated directional edge; volume gives intensity, not direction; 1 marginal DEV pass failed VALIDATION

why: and 0 usable survivors: that one failed VALIDATION (net -2 bp on 50 events vs +70 bp on DEV). Two further DEV-supported ideas (a time-of-day contrast and a pooled "volume confirms breakouts" premium, which looked very strong on DEV, p = 0.008)
both failed VALIDATION. HOLDOUT (2025-07 .. 2026-09) was never opened and is still sealed.

"No edge found" has limits (section 6): with 50-300 events, only effects larger than roughly 60-170 bp (4h, n about 200, 1 to 7 day holds) or 100-550 bp (daily, n 50-200) are detectable. Small effects are not excluded; they are also too small to trade after 1…
Verdict legend: NO-EDGE = tested with enough events and failed; INSUFFICIENT = too few events for the registered test, descriptive numbers only; NOT SUPPORTED = failed VALIDATION.
